# Judge audit: 50 judge calls to check by hand

*Generated by `judge_audit.py` (seed 11, --judge sonnet) from the sonnet judge (judge v2, Claude-judged, provisional). Do not edit by hand; fill the Your verdict lines.*

Each item is one referee concern and one review. The judge said whether the review raised the concern (**raised**), touched it (**partly**) or missed it (**not raised**). Read the concern and the excerpt and write your own verdict. For **not raised** there is no excerpt: open the review file and search it for the concern's topic.

Pool: 426 judge calls on 16 papers. In this sample: 14 raised, 16 partly, 20 not raised.
